claims.statement: Algolia lists a Usage API key among its other predefined API keys and shows it as the key for the Usage API, sent in the X-Algolia-API-Key header.

sources.supports: export ALGOLIA_API_KEY="your usage API key"; the X-Algolia-Application-Id header identifies which app you are accessing, and the X-Algolia-API-Key header authenticates the endpoint.
Other API keys: Monitoring API key, Usage API key, Analytics API key.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: This candidate is established only as existing: the prefix, alphabet, length and structure of the value are not documented on the pages read and are not researched.

The pages read do not say whether Algolia keys of different roles share one value shape; role must not be attributed from shape alone, and identification needs the surrounding context (header, variable name, ACL).
Whether the Usage API key is a distinct credential or an ACL profile of the same key kind as the other predefined keys is not settled by the pages read.
